verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful API that gives programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts and AI summaries. Users create their own API keys with chosen note-access scopes, and Business/Enterprise admins can also create non-expiring workspace keys. Action items appear only as a use case ("extract action items from meeting notes"), not as a documented API field. missing for 10: action items as a first-class API field, a published OpenAPI/endpoint reference (probe found none), clarity on plan gating for key creation, independent hands-on corroboration of the API.
